panels.description: Mean of max absolute PE deviation across 6 fiducial points. Green < 10µm, Amber 10-20µm, Red > 20µm.

targets.rawSql:
WITH MaxPE AS (
SELECT
   eqp_id, GREATEST(ABS(COALESCE(pe_1,0)),ABS(COALESCE(pe_2,0)),ABS(COALESCE(pe_3,0)),ABS(COALESCE(pe_4,0)),ABS(COALESCE(pe_5,0)),ABS(COALESCE(pe_6,0))) AS max_error 
FROM
   public.ldi_data 
WHERE
   factory IN ($Factory) 
  AND  process IN ($process) 
  AND  $__timeFilter(time) 
  AND  pe_1 IS NOT NULL) 
SELECT
   ROUND(AVG(max_error)::NUMERIC, 2) AS value 
FROM
   MaxPE

panels.description: Note: Alarm durations and MTTR are not calculated as the source EAP system currently does not broadcast explicit alarm-clear events. Only occurrence times are logged. Duration estimation requires EAP team confirmation of clear/reset event availability. Count of alarms with alarm_type='Critical' in the last 5 minutes.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
   COUNT(*)::NUMERIC AS value 
FROM
   public.ldi_alarm_log a 
LEFT JOIN
   public.ldi_alarm_ms_code m ON a.errorcode::TEXT = m.alarm_code::TEXT 
WHERE
   a.logdate >= NOW() - INTERVAL '5 minutes' 
  AND  m.alarm_type ILIKE '%Critical%'

panels.description: Latest production context per machine: job info + live physical parameters (temperature, humidity, scan_speed, thickness, resist_dosage, state).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
   DISTINCT ON (eqp_id) eqp_id AS "Machine", mo AS "Job (MO)", fpn AS "Part (FPN)", layer_name AS "Layer", (board_no::TEXT || '/' || total_board::TEXT) AS "Progress", ROUND(temperature::NUMERIC, 1) AS "temperature (°C)", ROUND(humidity::NUMERIC, 1) AS "humidity (%RH)", ROUND(scan_speed::NUMERIC, 1) AS "scan_speed (mm/s)", ROUND(thickness::NUMERIC, 3) AS "thickness (mm)", ROUND(resist_dosage::NUMERIC, 1) AS "resist_dosage", state AS "state" 
FROM
   public.ldi_data 
WHERE
   factory IN ($Factory) 
  AND  process IN ($process) 
  AND  $__timeFilter(time) 
ORDER BY
   eqp_id, time DESC 
LIMIT
   50

panels.description: Avg cycle time per board in 5-minute buckets. Hotter (redder) = slower cycle time.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
   time_bucket('5 minutes', time) AS time, eqp_id AS metric, ROUND(AVG(total_time / NULLIF(total_board, 0))::NUMERIC, 2) AS value 
FROM
   public.ldi_data 
WHERE
   factory IN ($Factory) 
  AND  process IN ($process) 
  AND  $__timeFilter(time) 
  AND  total_board > 0 
GROUP BY
   1, 2 
ORDER BY
   time

panels.title: total_time / total_board (s/board)

panels.description: 3-sigma Z-Score on temperature per machine. Green ±2 (normal), Amber 2.5 (watch), Red 3+ (anomaly).

targets.rawSql:
WITH stats AS (
SELECT
   eqp_id, AVG(temperature) AS mu, STDDEV(temperature) AS sigma 
FROM
   public.ldi_data 
WHERE
   time > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' 
GROUP BY
   eqp_id) 
SELECT
   d.time, d.eqp_id AS metric, ROUND(((d.temperature - s.mu) / NULLIF(s.sigma, 0))::NUMERIC, 2) AS "Z-Score" 
FROM
   public.ldi_data d JOIN stats s ON d.eqp_id = s.eqp_id 
WHERE
   factory IN ($Factory) 
  AND  process IN ($process) 
  AND  $__timeFilter(time) 
  AND  d.temperature IS NOT NULL 
  AND  s.sigma > 0 
ORDER BY
   d.time ASC

panels.title: Z-Score: temperature

panels.description: Top 5 machines with worst PE alignment excursion in current time range. Click Machine to drill to Snapshot.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
   time, eqp_id AS "Machine",
       GREATEST(ABS(pe_1),ABS(pe_2),ABS(pe_3),ABS(pe_4),ABS(pe_5),ABS(pe_6)) AS "Worst PE",
       GREATEST(ABS(je_1),ABS(je_2),ABS(je_3),ABS(je_4)) AS "Worst JE",
       log_id

FROM
   public.ldi_data

WHERE
   $__timeFilter(time)
  
  AND  pe_1 IS NOT NULL
  
  AND  COALESCE(pe_setting, 0) > 2.0

ORDER BY
   "Worst PE" DESC NULLS LAST

LIMIT
   5

panels.description: Note: Alarm durations and MTTR are not calculated as the source EAP system currently does not broadcast explicit alarm-clear events. Only occurrence times are logged. Duration estimation requires EAP team confirmation of clear/reset event availability. Alarm stream with errorcode, errortime, message, and severity. LEFT JOIN on ldi_alarm_ms_code for alarm details.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
   a.logdate AS "Time", a.equipmentid AS "Machine", a.errorcode AS "errorcode", a.logdate AS "errortime", COALESCE(m.alarm_msg, a.errorcode::TEXT) AS "Message", COALESCE(m.alarm_type, 'WARN') AS "Severity", COALESCE(m.alarm_detail, '') AS "Details" 
FROM
   public.ldi_alarm_log a 
LEFT JOIN
   public.ldi_alarm_ms_code m ON a.errorcode::TEXT = m.alarm_code::TEXT 
WHERE
   $__timeFilter(a.logdate) 
ORDER BY
   a.logdate DESC 
LIMIT
   30
